validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE: confirmed -- energybase.ru has a dedicated page for 'Pochinki-Penza' giving 4 spec values (Length=174km, Diameter=720mm, Construction=2009, Start=2011) that are ALL exact matches to GEM's recorded values, a strong internal-consistency signal. CLASSIFICATION: correctly a transmission trunk. DUPLICATE: not a duplicate of P0756/P2370/P2372 -- distinct destination (Penza) and distinct diameter/length. ATTRIBUTION: Gazprom PJSC ownership via Gazprom Transgaz Nizhny Novgorod confirmed by 2 independent sources. SPEC: all 4 numeric fields confirmed exact-match (single-sourced each, but internally consistent as a set). One adjacent finding surfaced during EXISTENCE/DUPLICATE checking: a fas.su article (dated per Wayback capture, sourced originally from penza-press.ru) describes a 2010-era PROPOSED, separate 'Pochinki-Saransk-Penza' duplicating/parallel pipeline (194km target), explicitly described as running parallel to an 'already-operating' pipeline -- i.e. this is a DIFFERENT, distinct project from P2371 itself (P2371 runs Pochinki DIRECTLY to Penza per energybase.ru, not via Saransk), proposed as a capacity-adding duplicate of whichever line was already serving Penza in 2010 (plausibly a predecessor to or component of the current Pochinki-Penza corridor). No GEM PID tracks 'Saransk' specifically (checked the current GEM snapshot). This is logged as a cross_row_lead / researcher note only -- it does NOT invalidate or contradict P2371's own well-sourced identity, and no evidence found that the Saransk-routed proposal was ever built as GEM's P2371 or as any other tracked row.
